evidence_quote: Total for all four plants = 20 (first two plants) + 60 (remaining two plants) = 80 tomatoes.
question_evidence_quote: The two remaining plants each bore three times the number of tomatoes as the first two plants combined.
observed_error: The final total counts only one 60-tomato contribution for the two remaining plants.
violated_condition: Each of the two remaining plants contributes 60 tomatoes, so their combined contribution is 2 × 60.
error_description: The response correctly determines that each remaining plant bore 60 tomatoes, but then uses 60 as the combined contribution of both remaining plants. The total must include two separate 60-tomato contributions alongside the first two plants’ 20 tomatoes. The written addition is evaluated correctly; the total omits one plant.
